name: Neural Signed Distance Field (NDF) Supervision via LiDAR
definition: A geometry neural network using hash encoding and tiny MLPs to encode a scalable signed distance field, supervised by direct 3D LiDAR points rather than pure images.
summary: Neural Signed Distance Field Supervision via LiDAR trains geometry networks using 3D LiDAR point clouds as direct supervision, converting distances into binary occupancy signals to learn surface boundaries from sparse returns.
